reason: A desktop interface customization plugin that provides preset or custom wallpapers, local image upload, persistent storage, and adjustable opacity.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用提供预设或自定义壁纸、图片上传、持久化存储和透明度调节功能。
summaries.en: Provides preset or custom wallpapers for the DeepSeek Harness desktop app with image uploads, persistent storage, and adjustable opacity.

capabilities: customizes the desktop app background wallpaper
accepts image URLs and local image uploads
stores wallpaper configuration and uploaded images on the host
serves the stored image through loopback HTTP routes
injects CSS to adjust background transparency and wallpaper opacity
